title: Travel Completed, APPR, AC operated, Cancellation Code DAMA (ANA), Uncontrollable, rebooked (6 to under 9 hour delay), single leg AC, Elite 35K
description:
An AC-operated itinerary where the original flight is involuntarily cancelled with code DAMA (ANA). A third-party ground vehicle damaged the aircraft, and it needed maintenance before it could fly. The customer is rebooked onto a later AC flight and arrives 7 hours late at YVR. Checks five things: (1) DDS confirms the leg is AC-operated, so there's no OAL redirect, (2) DDS uses the cancellation code DAMA (ANA) and classes it as uncontrollable, (3) the 7-hour delay is calculated from the original promise to the actual arrival on the rebooked flight, (4) Elite 35K status is recognised but doesn't override the uncontrollable outcome, and (5) the result is Not Eligible at CAD 0 with no payment flow.

Prerequisites:
PNR TC084: one passenger, Richard Clarke (Adult, Aeroplan Elite 35K 9876543210, good standing). Ticket stock 014- (AC issued). Original flight: AC 123 YYZ ? YVR, May 26, 2026, scheduled departure 09:00, scheduled arrival 14:00. Operating carrier: Air Canada (AC). Cancelled at D-1. Cancellation code: DAMA (ANA), aircraft damage by external source requiring maintenance, uncontrollable. Fallback: FALSE. INVOL rebooking onto AC 127 YYZ ? YVR, actual arrival 21:00 (7h, 6 to under 9 hour band). Status: Arrived. Filed June 5, 2026 (D+10, more than 72 hours after arrival, within 366 days). No duplicate. No expense receipts. CyberSource: not invoked. RDS: no flags. Country of residence: Canada.
